name: SwiftUI-Agent-Skill
description: SwiftUI agent skill for Claude Code, Codex, and other AI tools.
one_liner: Teaches an AI coding assistant the correct, idiomatic way to build iOS app screens in SwiftUI, so it stops writing clumsy or outdated code.
buyer: An iOS freelancer or small app studio who wants their AI coding assistant to write cleaner SwiftUI code on the first try, cutting review and rework time.
business_use_cases: An iOS consultancy adopts it internally to speed up client app builds with AI assistance that actually follows Apple's current patterns.
A solo app developer uses it to ship features faster without having to correct the AI's SwiftUI mistakes repeatedly.
A mobile bootcamp or course creator references it when teaching students how to pair AI tools with SwiftUI development.

money_ideas.idea: The well-known author can monetize via a paid advanced skill pack, book, or course bundled with this as a free lead magnet.

steal_this: Free developer tooling and a reputation-builder for its author, not a resellable product itself — the model worth copying is 'give away a focused skill, sell the deeper course.'
